subject: POC Observability plan and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@fintechx.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: POC follow-up: success criteria & observability plan

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today  great to meet the FintechX team. Per our conversation, I pulled together a proposed POC success criteria and an initial observability plan so we have clear signals during the trial. Please review and confirm or flag any gaps.

Summary / ask:
- Goal: 2-3 week POC to validate latency, cost and reliability for customer-facing transaction enrichment (avg payload ~120 tokens).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  * 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for single request path under expected QPS (20 sustained, 50 peak).
  * Error rate < 0.5% (failed requests or timeouts).
  * Token cost per 1k tokens within target budget ($X, final number after profiling).
  * No data leakage: all requests stay in FintechX VPC / private deployment (we discussed private connector).
- Observability & evaluation plan (items we need to monitor during the POC):
  1) Dashboards: per-route latency percentiles (p50/p90/p95/p99), request throughput, error rate, CPU/GPU utilization, token count per request.
  2) Tracing: end-to-end traces for slow requests with span for network -> Redwood inference -> response; sample 1% traces and retain on request IDs for debugging.
  3) Logs & exports: structured request logs (request_id, route, model_version, tokens_in/out, latency_ms, status) exported to your logging endpoint (S3/CloudWatch/BigQuery).
  4) Alerts: p95 latency > 300ms, error rate > 1% sustained for 5m, GPU memory thrashing alerts.
  5) Data retention/PII: agree on retention windows (30 days standard, can extend) and redaction for sensitive fields if needed.

Next steps / ownership:
- FintechX: confirm success criteria and provide evaluation priorities + access to a sample dataset (anonymized). Assign an internal owner for day-to-day coordination (you mentioned Priya).
- Redwood: we will stand up the POC environment, build baseline dashboards, and provide temporary read-only credentials for log export. Aditya will lead the instrumentation work; Connor will own dashboarding and alerting.
- Timeline: target start 2026-03-08, 2-week active evaluation, +1 week buffer for fixes/analysis (final report by 2026-03-29).

Attachment: redwood-poc-observability-checklist.pdf (checklist + recommended metrics).

If that looks good, can you confirm by EOD Friday and share the anonymized sample payloads?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Sam Park <sam@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@fintechx.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 17:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: success criteria & observability plan

Marissa  thanks, this is exactly the kind of structure we wanted. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Confirm Priya will be the FintechX owner for the POC (she's CC'd).
- For success criteria, can we add SLA-style pass/fail for two high-volume routes (payment_create, payout_status)? We'd like separate pass/fail per-route.
- We also care about tail token usage  please include per-request token distributions (histogram) so we can estimate cost outliers.
- Timeline: 03/08 start works but can we have a short kickoff call 03/06 to align on access and test dataset?

We'll provide anonymized request logs (sample 500 rows) and agree on the storage endpoint for log exports.

Sam
Head of Engineering
FintechX
sam@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@fintechx@fintechx.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: success criteria & observability plan

Thanks Sam  great asks, will incorporate. Quick updates:

- Per-route pass/fail: noted. We will create dashboard panels that show route-level pass/fail against the thresholds you specified (payment_create, payout_status).
- Token histogram: we'll add a per-request token distribution histogram and a table of top outliers (by cost).
- Kickoff: 03/06 16:00 UTC works for the Redwood technical team  sending calendar invite after confirmation.

Observability implementation notes (high-level):
- Dashboards: we will provision a Grafana dashboard with panels for the metrics above and share a read-only link.
- Tracing: we'll instrument end-to-end traces with trace IDs passed through X-Request-ID header; sample rate 1% by default, can increase if we need deeper debugging.
- Log export: we can stream structured logs to an S3 bucket or push to your CloudWatch/BigQuery. We'll need IAM creds or a signed S3 bucket policy.
- Retention: default 30 days, we can extend to 90 on request (note: longer retention will be additional cost).

Attachment: redwood-poc-observability-checklist.pdf (updated with per-route panels).

Aditya and Connor will follow up with specifics on what access they need.

Best,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam@fintechx.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 13:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: POC instrumentation/access needs

Looping in a few tech specifics so FintechX can provision before the kickoff:

- We need a service account / IAM role with write access to an S3 bucket (or equivalent) for structured log export. Format: JSON lines with fields {request_id, route, model, model_version, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, status, timestamp}.
- Network: If you're doing the private connector, ensure the outbound rules allow connectivity to our dedicated endpoint IP range (I'll share CIDR list in the kickoff).
- Sampling & tracing: default sample_rate=0.01 (1%). If you expect to hit an incident window for debugging, increase to 10% for a short period.
- Metrics to emit from your side: request route tag, client_region, and test_token_class (to correlate payload types).

Notes on security/compliance: we'll sign an NDA/DSA if necessary for sample data. We will not persist any PII; fields flagged as PII should be redacted before export.

Let me know if you want a short checklist of IAM policies.

- Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
